selection: per venue, the held-out A5 session with the most fingerprints

demos.title: UJI library, bookshelves, -12 dBm, 6 scans at one point
demos.description: UJI library, bookshelves, -12 dBm: a phone (Galaxy A5) standing still at a surveyed point (black square) for 6 BLE scans, about one per second. Grey outlines are the mapped shelves and pillars, dots the surveyed beacons. The point was held out of the path-loss fit; the filter has no steps to go on, only BLE. Default engine config. Results over all points are in docs/uji_ble.md.
